author: The Current
description:
Adam Voith, the curator of the Writers in Residence program at Eaux Claires Festival, spoke with host Nilufer Arsala about the importance of having a writing component at the festival. 

Listen and read to the full interview at thecurrent.org 

Find out more about The Current's broadcast plans with Rdio Milwaukee and Converge Media during Eaux Claires at thecurrent.org/eauxclaires 

#TheCurrent #EauxClairesFestival
